claim_boundary: Measures task difficulty against a proposer. No capability or self-improvement claim.
finding: A larger proposer moves tasks across the cliff rather than into the band. integer_cube_root went from unreachable to trivially solved; digit_ladder went the other way and now produces no valid output at all. round_half_to_even is the only task near the band at 83%, and its mean score of 0.815 shows partial solutions do occur, so it is not saturated. One borderline task is not a benchmark.
question: Does a larger proposer put any task in the intermediate band where search quality is observable?
